page.overview:
Who is Cyrus?

Cyrus was a minor antagonist in the fifth season of Jurassic World: Camp Cretaceous. Cyrus was one of the investors who came to Mantah Corp Island to meet with Daniel Kon alongside Mr. Gold and Lana Molina to see dinosaur fights.

Cyrus, Molina, and Mr. Gold arrive on Mantah Corp Island, When Kon greets them, Cyrus states that he will shoot something if he has to keep the VR Googles on any longer, to which Kon says they can take the googles off. Kon then brings them to the Compound. When Kon, brings his son, Kenji to the party, Cyrus shakes his hand and says he respects how he has bested the worst of the dinosaurs. They then hear Little Eatie roar, and Kon says he's just whetting their appetite for tomorrow, so they continue their conversation and listen to Kenji's stories of how he survived so many dinosaur encounters.

While walking to the Redwood forest for the presentation, Molina and Mr. Gold both get annoyed about how long its taking and request easier modes of transportation, Molina tells Kon that she can get her hands on some horses for him, Cyrus sparks interest in the idea and says they can watch dinosaurs eat them as well, then playfully punching Kenji telling him he would tell tickets to that. Kash then arrives to join the presentation, so Kenji brings Cyrus and the other investors through the airlock while Kon talks to him. During the Presentation, Cyrus took control of the Spinosaurus. He caused him to fight against Big Eatie and the 2 Velociraptors. When the Nublar Six, minus Kenji, came to stop the dino fights, he hopped on and caused the Spinosaurus to chase after them. This gave Ben Pincus the opportunity to disrupt the control chip in his head and free him from his mind control. After he escaped, the Spinosaurus ran toward Cyrus and gets eaten.

From his comments, he seems to enjoy violence and blood sports, with him quoting a line from [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mortal_Kombat an extremely violent fighting game franchise] and saying that he wanted to shoot something to satisfy him while waiting to fly to Mantah Corp Island and expressed disappointment and disinterest when told he wouldn't observe a dinosaur fight, but enjoyed controlling the dinosaurs and making them fight each other.
